prompt: Round 2 of 6. The company side proposes (We need a deployable result within twelve months and our data and know-how must stay protected. Because no labelled att

content.text:
The company wants contract_research_company_owns IP. My position requires university ownership. I need to counter with uni_owns_option_to_licence or similar. Also exclusivity 18 months is too long - max is 24 but 18 months in a broad field is concerning. I can accept 60-day review.

Key issues:
1. IP: must be university owned - I'll propose uni_owns_option_to_licence
2. Exclusivity: 18 months in "OT passive network monitoring and anomaly detection in edge sensors" - narrow it to EdgeWatch product line, keep 12 months

I can trade: accept 60-day review (give) to get uni_owns_option_to_licence (take). That's two field changes.
